title: Zakat: Business & Wealth
description: Basics of Zakat including calculation, nisab, eligible wealth categories, and distribution.
short_description: Understand your Zakat obligations and how to calculate them correctly

modules.title: Understanding Zakat
modules.description: The fundamentals of Zakat, its distinction from Sadaqah, and the concept of Nisab.

lessons.title: Is There a Difference Between Zakat and Sadaqah?
lessons.content: Understanding the key differences between Zakat (obligatory charity) and Sadaqah (voluntary charity), their respective rulings, and how each plays a role in a Muslim's financial life.

lessons.title: Nisab and Zakat Anniversary: What's That?
lessons.content: Learn about Nisab (the minimum threshold of wealth that makes Zakat obligatory) and the concept of the Zakat anniversary (Hawl) for determining when Zakat is due.

lessons.title: What is Missed Zakat?
lessons.content: Understanding the concept of missed or overdue Zakat, the ruling on paying back Zakat that was not paid on time, and how to rectify missed Zakat obligations.

modules.title: Calculating and Distributing Zakat
modules.description: How to calculate your Zakat and understand who the eligible recipients are.

lessons.title: Zakat Calculator
lessons.content: A practical walkthrough of how to calculate your Zakat, covering all eligible wealth categories including cash, gold, silver, investments, and business assets.

lessons.title: Who Are the 8 Zakat Recipients?
lessons.content: The eight categories of Zakat recipients as specified in the Quran (Surah At-Tawbah, 9:60): the poor, the needy, Zakat administrators, those whose hearts are to be reconciled, those in bondage, debtors, in the cause of Allah, and travelers.
